name: D_a
description: D_a - anti-pattern corpus for WCAG 2.4 focus-behavior repair. Each case re-creates, as a small runnable page, a failure pattern observed on the production sites scanned in the NavA11y study. Renamed from D_new; every case keeps its former identifier in legacyId.
provenance: Patterns were observed during the production scan of the NavA11y study. That scan stored per-criterion counts rather than per-element evidence, so no case carries an attribution to a named site.

cases.notes: Expected Success Criteria are those NavA11y reports when run on the finished page, not those intended when the case was authored.
